purpose: Teach: 精神病/思索/低温/男系/蛋白/環状/中等/疑似

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の精神病院制度史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the postwar history of psychiatric hospital systems, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant confirmation—genuine interest, not testing. Steady eye contact. Patient pause for response, giving space to be heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、哲学者の思索方法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on how philosophers approached thinking methodologically.
lines.style: Careful, precise articulation. Slight tension in the opening—wanting to get it right. Even pace, measured. Eye contact held but not aggressive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、低温物理学の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered low-temperature physics research, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly puzzled tone—noticing something. Gentle probe, not accusatory. Voice trails slightly, inviting clarification.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、王家の男系継承研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was working on royal lineage succession studies—specifically patrilineal inheritance.
lines.style: Quiet correction, patient but precise. No defensiveness, just clarifying. Steady, responsible tone. Slight emphasis on the specific terminology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蛋白質構造の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And protein structure research—you covered that in your paper?
lines.style: Engaged, attentive nod in the voice. Present and following closely. Light curiosity, not judgment. Natural conversational cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、都市の環状線設計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my research was on circular urban transit line design and planning.
lines.style: Gently patient correction. No frustration underneath—just steady, helpful clarification. Even tone, unhurried. Slight emphasis on 'actually' to signal the shift.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中等教育の課題研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on secondary education challenges in your paper, right?
lines.style: Reflective, genuinely checking understanding. Warm but observant—noticing the pattern, wanting to get it straight. Open ending inviting honest response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、疑似科学の見極め方を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my focus was on recognizing and identifying pseudoscientific claims.
lines.style: Clear, definitive close. Steady conviction without harshness. Slight sense of completion—wrapping up the thought carefully. Grounded, present.
